title: Filter displays by the channel they are playing
summary: Narrow the Displays & Devices list to the screens on a given display type and read the Active Playlist column to confirm which channel each is playing.
bodyMd:
To confirm that the right content is playing in the right places, filter the Displays & Devices list by display type and read the Active Playlist column. The playlist is the channel a display plays: every display type has a default playlist, so filtering by type shows every screen on that channel. Allow about 1 minute.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account.

Steps

  1. In the left navigation, select Displays & Devices.
  2. In the Type column header, open the filter and tick the display type whose channel you want to check, for example Landscape.
  3. Read the Active Playlist column for each display in the filtered list. Displays on the type's default playlist show its name, for example Landscape Playlist.
  4. To narrow further, enter a Store Code or Store Name, or add a Status filter of Online.
  5. To see which campaigns that playlist is putting on the screen, hover over the display's Playback Audit icon.

Verify it worked

The list shows only displays of the chosen type, and every row's Active Playlist value is the channel you expect.
